title: Workers' Compensation Referral Billing Calendar
content:
# Billing calendar — Workers' Compensation Referral

The billing office works each Workers' Compensation Referral to the periods below. They fix how soon a bill must be submitted after the date of service, whether a late bill can still be collected, when the payer's payment falls due, the penalty percentage for late carrier payment, when an unpaid bill is followed up, and how long a reduction or denial stays open to reconsideration.

| Program | Bill submission deadline (calendar days after date of service) | Untimely bill collectible | Payment due (calendar days after submission) | Late-payment penalty | Receivable follow-up (calendar days after submission) | Reconsideration window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Employer Direct Early Intervention | 30 | No | 30 | 0 percent | 35 | 30 |
| Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy | 75 | No | 60 | 10 percent | 45 | 90 |
| Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy | 75 | No | 60 | 10 percent | 45 | 90 |
| Work Conditioning Program | 75 | No | 60 | 10 percent | 45 | 90 |
| Work Hardening Program | 75 | No | 60 | 10 percent | 45 | 90 |
| Functional Capacity Evaluation | 75 | No | 60 | 10 percent | 45 | 90 |

## Terms

- **Bill submission deadline** — the calendar days after the date of service within which the bill must be submitted.
- **Untimely bill collectible** — whether a bill submitted after the deadline may still be collected from anyone.
- **Payment due** — the calendar days after bill submission within which the payer must pay.
- **Late-payment penalty** — the penalty, as a percentage of the unpaid charge, billed when the carrier pays after the payment-due period; 0 percent where none.
- **Receivable follow-up** — the calendar days after bill submission at which an unpaid bill is followed up with the payer.
- **Reconsideration window** — the calendar days after a reduced or denied payment within which reconsideration may be requested.

## Comparisons

- Employer Direct Early Intervention runs on shorter periods throughout: 30 days to submit, 30 days to pay, follow-up at 35 days and 30 days for reconsideration, with no late-payment penalty (0 percent).
- The five carrier-billed programs share one calendar: 75 days to submit, 60 days to pay, a 10 percent late-payment penalty, follow-up at 45 days and 90 days for reconsideration.
- No program lets a bill submitted after its deadline be collected from anyone.
